text:
Since your tracking hasn't moved in 4 or more business days, you qualify for a courier investigation, and I'm sorry for the worry. Please send us your order number via chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat) or email at help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day), and we'll open the investigation, which takes up to 5 business days.

If the package is found to be lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund. If you choose a refund to a card, it takes 5-10 business days once issued (3-5 for digital wallets).
